🐾 Welcome to Neko Infection! 🐾

You find yourself trapped within the confines of an enigmatic facility, an experience that seems to have lasted for ages, just like countless others before you. What horrors lie concealed within these walls, known only to a select few? Will you seize the opportunity to unravel the clandestine mysteries that haunt this place, or will you become another unfortunate soul, forever lost? 

🐾 Thanks for your incredible support! 🐾
